Raspberry Pizza Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:12am

Ingredients




1 cup flour
1 stick butter
8 ounces cream cheese
2 cups Cool Whip
1 cup powdered sugar
2 sm. pkg. raspberry Jello
2 cups hot water
2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen raspberries

Preparation

1 Mix together flour and butter. Pat in 9 x 13 inch pan and bake for 15 minute at 350 degrees. Whip together cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar; spread on cooled crust. Mix Jello, hot water and raspberries together; chill until syruppy. Pour on second layer and chill until firm.
